evidence: Original standard IS 8828:1996 was scheduled at Serial 10 of S.O. 189(E) (effective 17 August 2003 per Clause 1(2)). BIS Electrotechnical division harmonized IS 8828 with IEC 60898-1 to formulate IS/IEC 60898-1, transferring certification licensing to the successor standard.

Active canonical national standard for MCBs replacing legacy IS 8828:1996. S.O. 189(E) Serial 10 originally mandated IS 8828 from 17 August 2003; mandatory Scheme-I licensing transferred to IS/IEC 60898-1 under BIS transition guidelines without claiming the 2003 Gazette explicitly named the 2015 edition.
Fourth Revision published by BIS ETD 15 in 2026. Legal Gazette amendment from DPIIT is pending (unresolved).
Clause 5.3 of IS 456:2000 mandates that all coarse and fine aggregates shall conform to IS 383.
Clause 9.1 of IS 456:2000 specifies IS 10262 as the approved mathematical method for concrete mix proportioning.
Clause 5.6.1 of IS 456:2000 mandates high strength deformed steel bars shall conform to IS 1786.
Clause 5.1 of IS 456:2000 specifies Ordinary Portland Cement conforming to IS 269.
Clause 5.1 of IS 456:2000 specifies Portland Pozzolana Cement conforming to IS 1489 (Part 1).
Distribution transformer neutral and body earthing installations must conform to IS 3043.
PVC insulated cables (IS 694) are coordinated with MCBs (IS/IEC 60898-1) for overcurrent thermal protection under S.O. 189(E) regulations.
Both are personal protective headgear standards co-scheduled under the DPIIT Helmet QCO (S.O. 4649(E)).
Industrial safety helmets and safety footwear form core mandatory personal protective equipment for factory and construction workers.
Low-voltage downstream circuit breakers (IS/IEC 60898-1) coordinate with high-voltage upstream substation breakers (IS/IEC 62271-100) across distribution hierarchy.
